alerts.condition: Sector Synchronization: avg sector Corr21 rose > 10pt in 20 trading days
Macro Regime Warning: CorrelationTrend > +3% AND VIX 252d percentile > 70
Sector Leadership Narrowing: top-3 sectors > 70% of positive returns
alerts.reason: realized.json's sector block carries corr21/corr50/disp21/disp50/breadth per sector, not a per-sector RETURN series -- computing the top-3-sectors' share of positive returns needs raw stock returns, which is vol_realized.py's scope, not this module's; not approximated from a proxy.

alerts.condition: Systemic Risk Warning: CRP21 < -5% AND CorrelationTrend > 0

meta.backbone_date_note: asof = realized.json's own last date, the daily equity-return backbone; VIX and implied correlation are joined onto it by AS-OF (latest value on or before that date), never by looking ahead.
meta.null_handling: implied correlation pending (coverage < 80%) -- every implied-dependent tile/leg (CRP, the Dispersion Score's CRP leg, both dispersion signals, the module-13 hedge color, the module-21 covered-call signal, the regime-shift score's CRP leg) reads null with this reason whenever rho_imp is null/absent for asof. The module-21 Index Hedge Signal does NOT depend on CRP and stays live.
meta.dispersion_score_formula: 30%*CDF(z(CRP21,756d)) + 25%*CDF(z(CorrelationTrend,756d)) + 20%*Dispersion21Pctile3y (realized.json) + 15%*BreadthScore (realized.json) + 10%*VIX 252d percentile; legs null on a given day are DROPPED and the remaining weights renormalised to sum to 1 (score = sum(w_k*leg_k)/sum(w_k) over available legs). Bands: <20 Correlation Crisis, <40 Macro Dominated, <60 Neutral, <80 Dispersion Favorable, else Strong Dispersion.

market_regime_thresholds.priority_order: E > D > A > B > else C
market_regime_thresholds.E_correlation_shock: RealizedCorr21>35% AND CorrelationTrend>+5% AND VIX momentum(5d)>0
market_regime_thresholds.A_strong_stock_picker: rho_imp>RealizedCorr21 AND CorrelationTrend<0 AND BreadthScore>50 AND Dispersion21>Dispersion50
market_regime_thresholds.note: thresholds not numerically pinned by the brief (Breadth Healthy, Trend Neutral band) are this module's own documented choices.

meta.dispersion_signal_formula: strength = sum of 25-pt linear ramps score_gt(x,thr,span)=25*clip((x-(thr-span))/span,0,1), score_lt(x,thr,span)=25*clip(((thr+span)-x)/span,0,1); LONG uses CRP21>+5%(span5%), Trend<-2%(span2%), and BreadthStable (|BreadthScore-5d-ago|<=5pt, binary 25pt) -- the module-11 ImpliedCorrPctile>60 leg is folded into the CRP gate below rather than a 4th ramp (no per-day implied-correlation percentile series exists yet, only implied.json's static current value); SHORT uses CRP21<-5%(span5%), Trend>+3%(span2%), VIX Rising (momentum>0, binary 25pt), Correlation Expanding (CorrelationTrend>0, binary 25pt). Both signals are null whenever CRP21 is null (CRP is each module's own attractiveness gate).

hedge_engine_thresholds.module13_color_ladder: Red: CRP<-5% AND Trend>+5% AND RealizedCorr21>30% -> Overwrite LOW/PutHedge AGGRESSIVE. Green: CRP>+3% AND Trend<0 AND DispersionScore>60 -> Overwrite HIGH/PutHedge LOW. Orange: CRP<-3% AND Trend>+2% -> Overwrite NORMAL/PutHedge HIGH. Yellow (default when CRP in [-3%,+3%]): Overwrite NORMAL/PutHedge NORMAL.
hedge_engine_thresholds.module21_covered_call_signal: High: CRP>3% AND Trend<0 AND DispersionScore>60. Reduce: CRP<-5% AND Trend>3%. Normal: CRP in [-3%,3%].
hedge_engine_thresholds.module21_index_hedge_signal: Aggressive: RealizedCorr21>35% AND Trend>+5% AND SectorCorrExpansion(avg sector Corr21 vs 20d ago)>0. High: RealizedCorr21>30% AND Trend>0. Low: RealizedCorr21<20% AND Trend<0. Normal: default. NOT implied-dependent (no CRP input) -- stays live when CRP is null.

vix_analytics_formula.NdPctile: fraction of the trailing N-observation window (VIX's own trading calendar) <= today's value, *100
vix_analytics_formula.regime_bands: <10 Very Low, <30 Low, <70 Normal, <90 High, else Extreme (by the 252d percentile)

meta.regime_shift_formula: 25%*CDF(z(CorrelationTrend,756d)) + 20%*CDF(z(avg-sector-Corr21 20d change,756d)) + 20%*CDF(z(-1*BreadthScore 20d change,756d)) + 15%*(100-Dispersion21Pctile3y) + 10%*CDF(z(VIX momentum,756d)) + 10%*CDF(-z(CRP21,756d)); null legs dropped and weights renormalised, same rule as the Dispersion Score. Bands: 0-25 Stable Dispersion Regime, 26-50 Watch, 51-75 Regime Shift Likely, 76-100 Regime Shift Underway.
